candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.value == 10 ether) statement so calls with any msg.value can succeed, altering state changes and potential ether transfers.
Remove the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) statement so the pastBlockTime update and ether transfer can occur even within the same block timestamp.
Delete the pastBlockTime = block.timestamp assignment so pastBlockTime is never updated, allowing repeated calls within the same timestamp.
Delete the entire if-block that transfers the contract balance, so ether is never sent to the caller even when the condition is met.
Replace the transfer call inside the if-block with a selfdestruct to a different address, altering the ether movement and contract state.
Change the divisor in the block.number condition from 15 to 14, altering which blocks trigger the ether transfer.
Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 ether, altering which calls succeed and thus the contract balance and transfer eligibility.

Move the `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` statement above the two require checks so pastBlockTime is updated before the validity checks, potentially allowing the call to succeed when it should fail.
